tests: composition-state bytes unchanged by completed progression report
incomplete report leaves state bytes unchanged before explicit recovery
interrupted score run recovers and reaches later World-State/writeback

implementation.compatibility: Legacy v1 composition checkpoints without incomplete_ticks remain readable for inspection.
implementation.completed_semantics: Only tick-completed task-family runs are scored for progression, using exact request and invocation receipt verifiers.
implementation.incomplete_semantics: A referenced interrupted episode is returned as incomplete after all request identities are checked; it is not silently omitted, reconstructed, or promoted by the inspector.
implementation.state_read: Reads one bounded, canonical, digest-verified composition checkpoint via the explicit custody reader; no _state() recovery or state publication.

objective: Ensure progression inspection is genuinely read-only and preserves truthful incomplete episode state.
